fields.name: qCitizenship
fields.label: Nationality as shown on the passport you will use to travel to New Zealand

fields.name: qIssuingCountry
fields.label: Issuing country / territory of your passport
Enter your passport number exactly as it appears on your passport
Select the expiry date as shown on your passport

notices: You will need: a valid passport that you will use to travel to New Zealand; a credit card or debit card (Visa or Mastercard) to pay; an email address to contact you; a photo of your face, or a device like a mobile phone that can take one
NZD $23 for NZeTA, if applying on the web, or NZD $17 for NZeTA, if applying on the mobile app.
NZD $100 for the International Visitor Conservation and Tourism Levy (IVL)
The IVL helps pay for tourism infrastructure and conservation in New Zealand. You pay the IVL at the same time as your NZeTA.
Most NZeTA requests are processed within 72 hours. Complex NZeTA requests may take longer. Apply early and make sure your details match your passport.
An approved NZeTA is valid for 2 years.
Your photo will be collected and used as biometric information to establish a record of your identity, verify your identity, and assist in making a decision on your NZeTA request.
If your passport details are not correct you may not be able to travel.

steps.name: Making a New Zealand Traveller Declaration
notices: The earliest you can submit your New Zealand Traveller Declaration is 24 hours before you start your trip to New Zealand.
We will email you a reference number which you can use to update your declaration at any time, up until you reach passport control.
Answers must be provided in English.

Information you need to provide: Your passport, flight or sea voyage details and contact details including where you will be based in New Zealand; Your immigration status (if required); Details about your trip, including your recent travel history; Items you are bringing into New Zealand.
It will take approximately 10 minutes to complete.
